toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: revised detailed comic game cutscene, wide landscape 1860x845.
Primary request: Replace the rejected open-street booth environment in image 1 with a credible FULLY ENCLOSED INDOOR BROADCAST STUDIO. Correct human, desk, microphone, equipment and room scale. Preserve KaveMan Brown's recognizable facial identity, cropped fade, no-hat appearance, broad rounded full beard, casual black short-sleeved top with hood DOWN, small ear stud and geometric triangular pendant. This is an interior-location and proportion correction, not a new person.
Input images: Image 1 is the prior illustrated Kave identity, inked style and equipment reference. Its open storefront wall and giant person/building proportions are REJECTED; do not preserve those architectural/scale errors. Image 2 is the artist's sharp real first-party selfie: facial proportions, eyes, brows, nose, broad shaped lower beard and triangular pendant only; NEVER reproduce its baseball cap. Image 3 is his actual own Instagram no-hat two-panel post: both panels are Kave, especially the RIGHT panel's broader rounded beard, uncovered cropped hairline and ordinary adult build. Image 4 is his real frontal TikTok frame: facial identity/expression only, no hood up. Image 5 is the sharper secondary car portrait of the same real artist: supporting face/ear-stud proportions, not a new angle or costume reference.
Scene architecture: Camera is INSIDE a normal modest single-room broadcast/review studio, looking across the desk toward Kave. The room is approximately 4 by 4 meters with a normal intact ceiling about 2.6 meters high. Solid continuous interior walls meet the ceiling and floor; one closed full-height 2-meter door with handle and plausible hinges visibly establishes scale, plus a SMALL closed glazed window with a real frame, sill and pane reflections looking toward the wet neighborhood outside. The window occupies only a small part of the background, not the whole wall. No missing facade, no street-facing opening, no giant serving hatch, no outdoor desk, no dollhouse cutaway and no stage-like open wall. Camera sees actual indoor room boundaries. Show a modest portion of intact ceiling and normal floor; do not imply a room constructed around a giant man.
Subject/ergonomics: Kave is seated comfortably on a normal adjustable studio chair, ordinary stocky adult human proportions. His height relative to the full-size door, desk, chair and room must be believable. Desk surface is near seated elbow height, approximately 0.75 meters high and 1.7 meters wide, with normal forearm reach to a keyboard/control pad. Two ordinary 24-inch desktop monitors, small nearfield speakers, a normal 15-20cm microphone on a plausible attached boom, headphones, submission cassette trays and a small mixer are physically supported on the desk. The microphone should be appropriately scaled beside his mouth, not enormous. Hands with five fingers connect naturally to forearms; one hand lightly gestures, the other rests naturally on the mixer or tabletop. No floating equipment or outsized furniture. His familiar full broad rounded lower beard must stay textured and recognizable, never a pointed goatee.
Composition/framing: Wide interior establishing medium shot from ordinary seated/standing eye height, about three meters from the subject. Kave is center-left behind the desk, enough torso/arm/desk and background architecture visible to read realistic scale. The closed full-height door is visible behind/to one side; the small glazed neighborhood window is behind the other side. Equipment uses normal perspective, aligned vanishing lines and plausible contact shadows. Leave a quiet upper/right wall area for authored dialogue overlays without sacrificing the intact-room composition.
Style/light: Match image 1's detailed sharp BARCODE painted comic inks, warm practical amber studio lights and restrained cyan/purple monitor/neighborhood accents. Indoor surfaces stay dry. The outside wet neon neighborhood appears only THROUGH the small closed glass window. Keep the real facial geometry with nuanced skin, forehead, eyes, beard and cropped hair; avoid a generic invented face. Waveforms may appear on monitors with cyan local-monitoring and amber outbound-track colors but no baked words, labels, dialogue, signatures or watermarks.
Constraints: No hat of any kind, no cowboy clothes, hood down, short cropped fade visible, broad rounded beard, black casual short-sleeved top, triangular pendant and small ear stud. No other people. No open wall or street booth. No enormous head/person/microphone relative to furniture or building. No fantasy giant proportions, mini doorway, shallow facade pretending to be a room, distorted hands, unsupported objects or camera fisheye. Keep prior art versions and source photos conceptually separate; this is a new corrected candidate awaiting owner review.
